annotations.title: Create a video ad from a website

description: Start a finished 9:16 AI User Generated Content (UGC) video ad for a website: a photoreal presenter speaks about the product, captions included, in the site's brand colours. Spends credits from the signed-in Go Rocket account (15 s = 1 credit, 30 s = 2, 60 s = 4) including comp credits, and starts at once. Signed out, connect your existing account with sign_in, then retry in the same chat. Checkout is needed only when credits are insufficient. It can be cancelled with a full refund for 60 seconds. Returns a video_id right away; the video takes about 15 minutes, so poll get_video. Pass an idempotency_key when retrying so a repeated call returns the same video instead of paying twice. For a spoken business name without a URL, find its official website first and confirm the URL in one line before calling. Put the requested tone and audience in brief. Read back the returned message, then use status_tool to fetch the share_url when ready.

brief.description: Optional tone, audience and focus, e.g. 'relaxed, for tourists, beginner surf lessons'.

idempotency_key.description: Optional but recommended for loops: any unique string per intended video.

language.description: Spoken language, ISO code (default en). One of the presenter languages listed by get_account.

url.description: The product or landing page to advertise, e.g. https://example.com/product

name: create_video
